### GAME FOR CLOUD MASTER -- ideas stage, nothing built
NANCY [PAUSE] on my first design ("Blast Radius"), and she corrected my premise:
  THE HUB PROJECTS **ZERO** GAMES. Its category set is [aws, az-900, az-104, cloud, openstack];
  no child carries catalogCategories:['games'], so none of the 15 cloud games with category
  'games' can EVER appear. The single card on the Games shelf is an OpenStack Jeopardy REVIEW,
  surfacing only because the renderer maps review -> games.
  => A NEW GAME INHERITS THE SAME INVISIBILITY. The projection/category decision must land or the
     shelf still shows one card. That is a DATA decision (one line) vs ~1,400 lines of engine.
  Also: "Blast Radius" duplicated cloud-openstack-rescue-live (same premise, real hardware, real
  grader) and was brute-forceable (small finite action space + reset button).

IDEA SETS PITCHED (house convention = reskin a real game; cloud-flap=Flappy, cloud-hop=Doodle
Jump, cloud-destroyer=Asteroids):
  set 1 REJECTED: Scheduler/Tetris · Make the Packet Arrive/Pipe Mania · Cutover/Overcooked

### GAME RULES THAT GOVERN ANY BUILD (from memory, non-negotiable)
- NOT quiz-shaped. Player DOES the skill. Discrete choices only as true CYOA with consequences.
- Correct answer must never sit at a fixed index; shuffle + grade by identity.
- Explanatory text must be TRUE in every scenario it can appear in (cloud-iam-debugger fails this
  in prod TODAY, rounds 2 and 6 -- logged by Nancy).
- Action space must be large/combinatorial or it is brute force with a reset button.
- QC = PLAY it to the second move, fresh context per scenario (harness state latches an early pass).
- Cross-file pair: ContentCatalog entry + HubRegistry catalogCategories. Omit one = invisible ship.
- games-marathon.md contract is IMPROVE-EXISTING and shield-scoped; Game Forge MVP was explicitly
  "no new-game generation". Neither is a build-new workflow.
